title: Ottilie: A Socially Intelligent Virtual Host for Sales-Driven Live Commerce
abstract: arXiv:2605.14542v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A skilled live-commerce host is not merely a narrator, but a sales agent who converts viewer curiosity into purchase intent through expert product knowledge, emotionally intelligent response tactics, and entertainment that serves as a vehicle for product exposure. Yet no existing AI system replicates this. Conversational recommenders treat recommendation as a terminal act, while general-purpose LLMs hallucinate product claims and default to generic promotional templates that fail to engage or persuade. We present Ottilie, a sales-conversion-oriented virtual host for Chinese beauty live commerce that grounds product responses in a verified knowledge base, adapts discourse strategy to viewer intent through empathetic amplification, evidence-backed rebuttal, and humor-mediated deflection, and supervises all four output fields simultaneously within a structured generation framework. Experiments demonstrate gains of 14% on informativeness

translated_title: Ottilie：面向销售驱动直播电商的社交智能虚拟主播
translated_abstract: 一名优秀的直播电商主播不仅仅是一名叙述者，更是一名销售代理人，通过专业的产品知识、具有情感智能的回应策略，以及作为产品曝光载体的娱乐内容，将观众的好奇心转化为购买意愿。然而，目前尚无AI系统能够复现这一能力。对话式推荐系统将推荐视为一次性的最终行为，而通用大语言模型则会在产品描述上产生幻觉，并默认使用无法吸引或说服观众的通用促销模板。我们提出了Ottilie，一个面向销售转化的中文美妆直播电商虚拟主播，它将产品回应建立在经过验证的知识库之上，通过共情式放大、基于证据的反驳和幽默调节的转移等策略根据观众意图调整话语策略，并在结构化生成框架内同时监督所有四个输出字段。实验表明，在信息性方面取得了14%的提升
tldr: Ottilie是一个面向销售转化的中文美妆直播虚拟主播，通过将产品回应锚定在验证知识库、根据观众意图动态调整共情放大、证据反驳与幽默转移等话语策略，并在结构化生成框架中同时监督四个输出字段，实现了观众好奇心向购买意愿的转化。
